source_provenance.notes: The controller, finite-number projection, Core envelope adapter, bounded cursor state, export, evidence UI, config parser, static registration, and MDP diagnostic archive projection are native feature modules. SMA/EMA/MACD/Bollinger and RSI relative-strength fallback preserve pinned legacy formulas; zero-average-loss RSI uses RS=100 (about 99.01, including a flat window). VWAP is cumulative over explicitly loaded rows and labeled loaded-window. Core Bars V1, MDP diagnostic archive, and Yahoo daily observations are separate contracts and series. MDP charting consumes only the fixed `market.archive.diagnostic-bars` operation and validated MDP Bars V1 response; the response is bounded to one archive window with no cursor/pagination or live updates. No quote/trade-derived candles or fabricated chart rows are implemented; if a validated archive response identifies synthetic observations, the chart labels them synthetic. No night coverage, live bar updates, or correction claims are added.
